tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (first stop of the body gradient). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: aurora-cyan
tokens.usage: Northern lights magic, scientific discovery, celestial. Used as text on `.logo:hover`, `.coordinate-label`, `.weather-temp`. 1.7:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: aurora-cyan-dark
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.btn-outline`. 3.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: ice-white

tokens.name: expedition-orange
tokens.usage: Safety equipment, emergency visibility, survival. Used as shadow/glow on `.btn-primary:hover`, `.btn-expedition`, `.btn-expedition:hover`.

tokens.name: arctic-navy
